prompt: Stop any UPI payment above 50k coming from a phone added in the last week, unless the merchant is on our whitelist.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount > 50000 AND device.age_days < 7 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Anything over one lakh should go to a human for review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 100000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: We don't accept payments from rooted phones.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Whitelisted merchants always go through.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Decline card payments made between midnight and 5 AM.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.hour < 5 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: If someone has failed more than 3 times in the last day, make a person look at their next payment.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 3 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Accounts younger than 30 days can't spend more than 10,000 rupees.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Reject foreign payments from users without KYC.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Ten or more transactions in an hour looks suspicious, flag it.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 10 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Small grocery purchases under 500 rupees are fine, approve them.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.amount < 500 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Block gaming and electronics purchases on brand new devices.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GAMING, ELECTRONICS] AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Send late-night wallet payments for manual checking; by late night I mean 11 PM or later.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.hour >= 23 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Net banking transfers of at least 5 lakh need review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.amount >= 500000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Unverified users shouldn't be able to pay more than 2000 rupees.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 2000 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Let utility bill payments through as long as KYC is done.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Flag travel bookings over 75,000 rupees paid from outside India.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount > 75000 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Card testing rule: more than 15 payments in an hour, each below Rs 50, on a card. Block them.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 15 AND txn.amount < 50 AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Reject payments if the phone is rooted or the user has more than 5 failures in the past 24 hours.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted OR user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: New accounts paying by UPI at night must be reviewed.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.method == UPI AND txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Approve everything from devices older than a year.
rule: WHEN device.age_days > 365 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Food orders are okay unless they cross 20,000 rupees.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND NOT txn.amount > 20000 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Payments that aren't UPI or card should be checked by the team.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.method IN [UPI, CARD] THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Domestic payments of Rs 100 or less can pass straight through.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount <= 100 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Hold anything from a non-whitelisted gaming merchant.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == GAMING THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Deny payments from accounts created in the last 3 days if they're above 25000.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 3 AND txn.amount > 25000 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Review international wallet payments.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.method == WALLET THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: If the device has been around for at least 90 days and KYC is complete, approve.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 90 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Decline payments after 10 PM from merchants not on the whitelist.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 22 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: A customer with 2 or more failed attempts on a new device should get reviewed.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Any electronics purchase of 1 lakh or more, flag it unless the account is over a year old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount >= 100000 AND NOT user.account_age_days > 365 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Block high-velocity traffic: over 50 transactions in an hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 50 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Allow net banking and wallet payments under 1000 rupees.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, WALLET] AND txn.amount < 1000 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Flag payments at night that are also above 5000 rupees.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 6 AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Reject mule-looking activity: account under two weeks old, no KYC, UPI, at least 40,000 rupees.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 14 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount >= 40000 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: If the merchant isn't in grocery, food or utilities, and the phone is rooted, block it.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GROCERY, FOOD, UTILITIES] AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Review payments before 8 in the morning from accounts less than 60 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 8 AND user.account_age_days < 60 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Payments over 2 lakh are blocked for non-KYC users, or for anyone on a rooted device.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 200000 AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Automatically approve whitelisted merchants when the amount is at most 50 thousand.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 50000 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Send cross-border card payments over Rs 10000 to review.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Do not allow travel payments if the device is under 3 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND device.age_days < 3 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Transactions with no failed attempts in 24 hours on verified accounts go through.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Flag anything that isn't a UPI payment if it's above ₹25,000.
rule: WHEN txn.method != UPI AND txn.amount > 25000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Block rooted devices using a wallet.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method == WALLET THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: If it's a new account or a new device and the amount is above 30000, hold for review.
rule: WHEN (user.account_age_days < 30 OR device.age_days < 7) AND txn.amount > 30000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Approve repeat low-value food orders: at most 5 transactions in the last hour and under 300 rupees.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND txn.count_1h <= 5 AND txn.amount < 300 THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Decline all payments of 10 lakh and above.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 1000000 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Check by hand any gaming payment made from 9 PM onwards.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.hour >= 21 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Users who haven't completed KYC may not pay internationally.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Pass payments from devices at least 6 months old, meaning 180 days, on whitelisted merchants.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 180 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Either 10 failed attempts or more, or more than 20 payments in the hour: block.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 10 OR txn.count_1h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Flag card or wallet payments over 1 lakh from accounts younger than 90 days.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, WALLET] AND txn.amount > 100000 AND user.account_age_days < 90 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: Reject domestic payments above 5 lakh at night.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 500000 AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Approve everything before noon from verified users.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 12 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: Merchants outside the whitelist selling electronics get reviewed if the bill tops 40000.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount > 40000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: No payments allowed on a device that's only 1 day old or newer.
rule: WHEN device.age_days <= 1 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Review payments of exactly 99999 rupees, those look like limit probing.
rule: WHEN txn.amount == 99999 THEN REVIEW reason="r"

prompt: When a rooted phone pays a travel or gaming merchant, deny it.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GAMING] THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Let verified users with accounts over 2 years old (730 days) through on UPI.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND user.account_age_days > 730 AND txn.method == UPI THEN ALLOW reason="r"

prompt: International payments on new devices are always blocked, whatever the amount.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="r"

prompt: Flag utilities payments over 15000, since bills are rarely that high.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.amount > 15000 THEN REVIEW reason="r"
